user_problem: I tune PostgreSQL-like database configs across workload classes and data sizes. I need to cross config profiles with OLTP/analytics/mixed workloads, catch under-provisioned combinations, and compare p95 latency, cost, and stability.
bundle_offer: Bundle models DB config profile as FW_Cartes(WORKLOAD), crossing each config profile with each workload class, then crosses that matrix with data size. The TAIL oracle catches workload-specific under-provisioning and the Analyzer exposes p95/cost/stability trade-offs.

zen_mapping.freedom: DB config profile crossed with workload class

zen_mapping.shape: exactly one of a set, set aside as the Cartes operand

oracle: FW_VAR=2 analytics workload under-provisioned when work_mem < 64 MB; FW_VAR=3 OLTP workload under-provisioned when pool_size < 32; FW_VAR=0 acceptable

reasons: each FW_Optional slot independently multiplies the post-sieve candidate space
product includes BOUNDED factor(s); range multiplies componentwise (lower×lower, upper×upper)

best_candidates.reason_non_dominated: champion: strictly best minimize p95_ms (p95_ms=1.000) on the 3-point Pareto front
champion: strictly best minimize cost_units (cost_units=2.250) on the 3-point Pareto front
champion: strictly best maximize stability_score (stability_score=9.000) on the 3-point Pareto front

pareto_front_note: the formal front is over ALL executed candidates; DOMAIN_FAIL members are findings, not deployable — pick the best PASS candidate to deploy
domain_fail_examples: app=db_config config=analytics_heavy workload=oltp data_size=small p95_ms=1.00 cost_units=9.50 stability_score=6 FW_VAR=3
app=db_config config=low_mem workload=analytics data_size=small p95_ms=95.45 cost_units=2.25 stability_score=7 FW_VAR=2
pass_example: app=db_config config=balanced workload=analytics data_size=large p95_ms=130.41 cost_units=8.40 stability_score=9 FW_VAR=0
teaching_summary: User problem (DB-config tuning / FW_Cartes workload matrix). Ran 18 candidates: 12x PASS (config/workload/data-size combination accepted), 2x analytics workload under-provisioned: work_mem below 64 MB, 4x OLTP workload under-provisioned: pool_size below 32. Formal Pareto front of 3. Verbs: DB config profile crossed with workload class -> FW_Cartes(WORKLOAD); workload class operand -> FW_Combi(1) + FW_Exclude; data size -> FW_Combi(1); workload/config compatibility -> TAIL oracle (FW_VAR). NOTE: 2 of 3 Pareto-front candidates are DOMAIN_FAIL (findings, not deployable): the formal front is over ALL executed candidates; DOMAIN_FAIL members are findings, not deployable — pick the best PASS candidate to deploy.
